snippet.title: Samson - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Samson, an upcoming third-person action-adventure developed by Liquid Swords. Players will fight their way through the city of Tyndalston with enemies around every corner and a sister that needs saving. Engage in intense close-quarters fights, get behind the wheel of high-powered vehicles, and explore a sprawling open-world. Samson is launching on April 8 for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#IGN #Gaming
